headline: RC auto: -1,3% over the year, but +3,7% in the first half
summary: The average premium for insuring a four-wheeled vehicle in Italy in July 2026 was 646.97 euros, down over the year, according to the RC Observatory. Premiums are up 3.7% in the first half.
why: Motor third-party liability (RC auto) is a large, regulated part of Italy's non-life insurance market, and its pricing feeds into insurers' underwriting results and household costs.
